sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi không đồng ý với mức giá đó is the quick money check before you agree to a ride, ticket, item, or service. It keeps the exchange focused on I did not agree to that price, so the answer can be a number, calculator screen, or typed price.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask Tôi không đồng ý với mức giá đó before you hand over money. Keep the item, ticket, ride screen, or calculator visible so the price can be shown instead of explained quickly.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this before you agree, pay, ride, buy, or enter. It is strongest when the item, destination, service, or ticket is visible and you want the number confirmed clearly.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Numbers are easier to trust when they are visible. Ask the short phrase first, then invite a typed number, calculator screen, ticket, or written time if the answer comes too fast.
